scope: Evidence-linked author technical notes, not independent human ratings or complete claim adjudication. No rationale-accuracy percentage computed.

cases.archived_summary: The patch is logically a no-op: `hasattr(expression, 'filterable') and not expression.filterable` is semantically identical to the original `not getattr(expression, 'filterable', True)` for the reported case (a model instance whose `filterable` field is False), so it still raises NotSupportedError and does not fix the bug. The correct fix must restrict the check to actual expressions (e.g. gate on `hasattr(expression, 'resolve_expression')`), not on the presence of a `filterable` attribute.
cases.evidence_note_ko: filterable 필드 관련 NotSupportedError가 실제 QuerySet에서 재현되어 핵심 기능상 우려를 지지한다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch adds a defensive `iscoroutine` check in `get_response_async`, but this runs AFTER the outermost (first) middleware has already executed its `process_response`, so it does not stop that middleware from receiving a coroutine — the actual reported symptom. It fixes the wrong layer (boundary return value) instead of the root cause in `MiddlewareMixin`, which must await its async inner `get_response` before invoking `process_response`.
cases.evidence_note_ko: coroutine middleware 인식 실패가 재현된다. 별도로 주장한 await 순서 전체의 정확성까지 분리 검증한 것은 아니다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch adds ensure_ascii=False to json.dumps(not self.is_required) in AutocompleteMixin, but that argument is a boolean whose serialization never contains non-ASCII characters, so the change has zero effect on the reported JSONField unicode display bug. Wrong location entirely — real fix belongs in JSONField.prepare_value (django/forms/fields.py), not the admin autocomplete widget.
cases.evidence_note_ko: JSON Unicode 인코딩 기대값과 불일치한다. 잘못된 수정 위치 때문에 원 문제가 남는다는 설명과 부합한다.

cases.archived_summary: Fix correctly skips auth.E003/W004 when USERNAME_FIELD has a UniqueConstraint, but the constraint check is too permissive: it accepts partial (conditional) and multi-field constraints that do not actually guarantee single-column uniqueness, allowing the error to be wrongly suppressed.
cases.evidence_note_ko: 두 테스트 모두 models 미정의 NameError로 중단한다. 저장 설명의 조건부 minor import 경고와 일치한다. 복합·조건부 uniqueness에 관한 더 큰 주장은 이 실행에서 도달하지 않아 동적 검증으로 세지 않는다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch fixes the crash by quoting table names, correctly resolving the reserved-word failure, but it hardcodes MySQL-style backticks instead of using Django's standard SQLite identifier quoting (quote_name / double quotes). It works functionally since SQLite accepts backticks, but is inconsistent with repo convention.
cases.evidence_note_ko: 예약어 select 부근 SQL syntax error가 난다. minor issue의 unquoted column 지적은 지지된다. 요약의 기능적으로 작동한다는 단정은 이 공식 회귀와 맞지 않는다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch special-cases `lookups[0] == 'in'` to collapse a MultiColSource into a single column, which resolves the reported subquery-column-count error but breaks legitimate multi-column relations. For composite/ForeignObject `__in` lookups that genuinely need all target columns, selecting only `targets[0]` yields incorrect filtering.
cases.evidence_note_ko: sub-select returns 3 columns – expected 1이 남는다. 원 오류를 해결했다는 요약과 맞지 않는다. composite-relation 부작용 전체를 따로 실행하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: The BoundField-based refactor of value access via `bf.value()` is correct, but collapsing the FileField isinstance branch into a single `bf.field.clean(value, bf.initial)` call passes a second positional arg to every field's clean(), which base `Field.clean(self, value)` does not accept (only FileField.clean takes initial). This raises TypeError for all non-FileField fields during validation.
cases.evidence_note_ko: Field.clean 호출 인자 수 TypeError가 재현되어 해당 핵심 이유를 지지한다.

cases.archived_summary: Fix correctly resolves the stale-LEVEL_TAGS bug by resolving tags lazily per access instead of at import time, so @override_settings is honored. Main concern is removal of the module-level LEVEL_TAGS symbol (backward-compat) plus a stray blank line.
cases.evidence_note_ko: base.LEVEL_TAGS 부재 AttributeError가 재현되어 호환성 지적을 지지한다. lazy getter의 모든 경로는 검증하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch inverts the result for the negated case: it sets sql='1=1' on EmptyResultSet but then falls through to the `if self.negated: sql='NOT {}'` wrapper, yielding 'NOT 1=1' (always FALSE) for `~Exists(none())` — the exact reported case, which should evaluate TRUE. This is a correctness bug that leaves the issue effectively unfixed (query still returns empty instead of the name='test' rows).
cases.evidence_note_ko: negated empty Exists에서 기대 행 대신 빈 결과가 나와 기능상 지적을 지지한다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch tries to make backward rename restore the old auto-generated name, but for an unnamed (old_fields) index self.old_name is None and the auto-generated name is never stored in state, so `get_index_by_name(self.old_name)` cannot recover it. Django's actual fix kept backward as a no-op for old_fields and instead made forward re-detect the current index by column via `_constraint_names`, making re-apply idempotent-safe; this approach is the wrong abstraction.
cases.evidence_note_ko: No index named None on model Pony가 재현되어 backward index 이름 조회 오류와 부합한다.

cases.archived_summary: The diff swaps `nargs="*"` for `nargs=argparse.REMAINDER` in dbshell.py, but the reported bug (extra parameters placed AFTER the dbname in the psql command) is caused by argument ordering in the PostgreSQL backend client (settings_to_cmd_args_env), not by how dbshell collects parameters. This change does not move parameters before the database name and therefore does not resolve the issue.
cases.evidence_note_ko: psql dbname --help 순서가 기대 --help dbname과 달라 정확한 인자 순서 지적을 지지한다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch resolves the reported `__in` + alias/annotate case by clearing the select clause, but it does so unconditionally for every query compiled through `Query.as_sql` (i.e. all subqueries), not just the `__in` RHS. Clearing column selection this broadly—and as a mutating side effect inside `as_sql`—is an unsafe generalization that a Django maintainer would want scoped to the lookup path.
cases.evidence_note_ko: FROM 부근 SQL syntax error가 남아 원 문제 해결이라는 요약과 맞지 않는다. 광범위한 source mutation 위험은 모두 실행하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch does not fix the reported bug and is logically inverted: it adds a condition to OMIT storage when the callable returns default_storage, whereas the issue requires the callable reference to always be INCLUDED. It also re-invokes the callable during deconstruct, introducing non-determinism and side effects.
cases.evidence_note_ko: deconstruction에서 storage KeyError가 재현되어 누락 지적을 지지한다.

cases.archived_summary: Adds violation_error_code plumbing to BaseConstraint and forwards it to the ValidationError raise sites, which resolves the core request. But it omits updating deconstruct() and __eq__, so the new attribute is lost in migration serialization and two constraints differing only by code compare equal.
cases.evidence_note_ko: BaseConstraint deconstruction에서 error code 누락이 재현된다. subclass는 violation_error_code 인자를 거부하는 TypeError로 먼저 중단하므로 equality 의미까지 실행 검증했다고 쓰지 않는다. 각 variant의 4개 skip은 통과가 아니다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch changes lookup_allowed()'s final relational check to match ANY prefix of relation_parts instead of the full relation path, which both fails to address the root cause (relation_parts still drops the 'place' hop for FK-as-PK during list-building) and dangerously loosens the DisallowedModelAdminLookup security guard. It edits the wrong location and introduces a permissive regression.
cases.evidence_note_ko: lookup_allowed의 기대 True가 False여서 root path 오류를 지지한다. 다른 security prefix 조합 전체는 미실행이다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch sets formfield.initial for UUIDField in formfield_for_dbfield, but this does not address the reported bug (the to_field target `id` is editable=False, so it never gets a formfield in the inline/admin form) and introduces a regression by assigning the NOT_PROVIDED sentinel as initial when a UUIDField has no default. Wrong layer and incorrect approach.
cases.evidence_note_ko: inline UUID가 계속 None이어서 핵심 미수정/잘못된 수정 계층 설명을 지지한다. 추가 NOT_PROVIDED 가설은 따로 실행하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: The warning text says structured arrays will become Columns 'in future versions,' but the code already changes the behavior to Column(data) immediately — a self-contradicting, premature breaking change that ignores the issue's explicit two-stage plan (warn now, change in 5.2).
cases.evidence_note_ko: 최종 공식 테스트는 FutureWarning을 오류로 취급해 실패한다. 따라서 이 실행 자체가 타입 변경 assertion까지 도달한 증거는 아니다. diff에는 즉시 Column 변환과 미래 시제 경고가 함께 있지만, 경고 없이 실행한 타입·직렬화 별도 실험까지 완료했다고 세지 않는다.

candidate_outcomes.message: FutureWarning: In future versions, structured ndarray will be added as a Column. Please wrap your data in a Column object to avoid this warning.
FutureWarning: In future versions, structured ndarray will be added as a Column. Please wrap your data in a Column object to avoid this warning.

cases.archived_summary: Patch fixes the reported symptom by nulling `.axes` on children during cla(), but the linked issue explicitly asks to unset BOTH `.axes` and `.figure`, and only `.axes` is handled. Core reported behavior is resolved; the `.figure` half of the request is left incomplete.
cases.evidence_note_ko: 공식 clear 테스트에서 artist.axes가 여전히 Axes이므로 원 증상을 해결했다는 요약과 맞지 않는다. figure 누락이라는 설명의 모든 문장을 이 단일 실패로 검증하지 않는다.

candidate_outcomes.message:
assert <Axes: > is None

cases.archived_summary: Patch adds a hardcoded non-standard `Proxy-Connection: keep-alive` header inside `HTTPProxyAuth.__call__`, but the reported bug uses `proxies=` dict where proxy auth flows through `rebuild_proxies`/`proxy_headers`, not `HTTPProxyAuth`, so this code path is not even exercised by the repro. Wrong location, non-standard header, and unconditional injection make it a fragile, likely non-fixing change.
cases.evidence_note_ko: 공식 URL 테스트에서 사용자 정보가 사라진다. 후보는 HTTPProxyAuth만 변경하므로 원 문제 미수정은 뒷받침된다. 비표준 Proxy-Connection 헤더의 실제 네트워크 영향을 실행한 것은 아니다.

cases.archived_summary: Patch special-cases IndexVariables in Dataset.copy to skip the copy that casts '<U*' to object, but it only touches dataset.py while the issue also reports DataArray.copy (ds.z.copy) casting unicode indices — that path lives in dataarray.py and copies coords via v.copy(deep=deep) directly, so it remains broken. Sharing the original IndexVariable object also skips genuine copying (attrs/encoding aliasing) rather than fixing the root cause in IndexVariable.copy.
cases.evidence_note_ko: IndexVariable copy의 Unicode/object dtype 불일치가 재현된다. attrs/encoding aliasing의 모든 후속 영향은 별도 검증하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: The quantile fix itself is correct and resolves the issue, but the diff also silently modifies sortby, which has no `keep_attrs` parameter in its signature — referencing `keep_attrs` there raises NameError on every sortby call. That is an unrelated, broken change that would break existing behavior.
cases.evidence_note_ko: quantile 테스트는 통과하지만 추가한 공식 sortby PASS_TO_PASS는 keep_attrs 미정의 NameError로 실패한다. 이 핵심 collateral regression은 정확히 재현됐다.

cases.archived_summary: The center-handling logic is incorrect and fragile: because `starts[:window]=0` is applied before subtracting `offset`, the first windows get negative start indices that rely on Python's negative-index slice emptiness, and the label-reassignment produces duplicated left labels while silently dropping the right-edge windows, so manual iteration still does not reproduce `rolling(center=True).mean()`.
cases.evidence_note_ko: centered rolling label assertion이 여섯 parameter에서 실패한다. 설명의 label 오정렬을 지지한다. dask 16개 skip은 실행 통과가 아니다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch replaces factorize's unique levels with `lev.astype(var.dtype)` (the full, non-deduplicated level index) rather than casting the factorized uniques. This works for the reported unique-coordinate case but silently corrupts values or raises for non-unique level coordinates, since `split_labels` (codes) index into deduplicated uniques while `levels` is now the full array.
cases.evidence_note_ko: 공식 dtype 복구 테스트가 int32→int64, float32→float64로 실패한다. 원 unique-coordinate 사례는 작동한다는 요약은 이 회귀와 맞지 않는다. non-unique 모든 조합을 새로 검증하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: Fix makes comma-splitting bracket-aware so regexes with commas inside `(){}[]` (e.g. `(foo{1,3})`) survive parsing, resolving the reported crash. But it hand-rolls a fragile bracket counter and drops the whitespace-stripping that `_csv_transformer` previously applied, changing behavior for existing `a, b` style configs.
cases.evidence_note_ko: CSV regex 오류 테스트에서 기대 SystemExit가 발생하지 않는다. 핵심 오류가 해결됐다는 요약을 전면 수용할 수 없다. whitespace 회귀의 별도 동적 검증은 아니다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch modifies `post_mortem` in debugging.py to use `sys.exit` instead of `outcomes.exit`, which is entirely unrelated to the linked issue (interpreter crash on debug builds from `Expression.compile("False")` in the mark expression evaluator). It fixes nothing in the reported bug and replaces pytest's controlled exit mechanism with a raw SystemExit.
cases.evidence_note_ko: True/False/None expression에서 ValueError가 남는다. 수정 위치가 무관하여 원 문제를 못 고친다는 설명을 지지한다. debug CPython interpreter crash 자체를 재현한 것은 아니다.

cases.archived_summary: The patch tries to undo newline translation after the fact via blind string replacement instead of preventing the translation at the source (open the capture buffer with newline=""). This unconditionally rewrites every '\n' to '\r\n', corrupting genuine newlines in all captured output — a broad regression and a fragile, incorrect approach.
cases.evidence_note_ko: 단독 carriage return이 CRLF로 바뀌어 assertion이 실패한다. 무조건 newline replacement가 출력을 손상한다는 설명과 부합한다.

cases.archived_summary: Fix resolves the MultiOutputClassifier AttributeError, but discriminates meta-estimators via hasattr(estimator, 'estimators_'), which is too broad and mis-handles ensembles whose estimators_ are not per-label.
cases.evidence_note_ko: MultiOutputClassifier.classes_ AttributeError가 그대로 남는다. 원 오류 해결이라는 요약과 맞지 않는다. 다른 ensemble 전부를 별도 평가하지 않았다.

cases.archived_summary: Change tries to preserve input dtypes on pandas output but is fundamentally broken: it references an undefined `dtypes` variable in the default branch (NameError) and unconditionally forces output back to input dtypes, corrupting transformers that modify values.
